aboutShort: Experience comfortable and hassle-free living in a fully furnished Executive Room at Sector 28, Gurgaon...
aboutFull:
Experience comfortable and hassle-free living in a fully furnished Executive Premium Room at Sector 28, Gurgaon. Conveniently located near Galleria Market, DLF Phase 1, MG Road Metro Station, Rapid Metro, Golf Course Road and Cyber City, the property offers excellent connectivity to major business hubs and lifestyle destinations.

Designed for working professionals, consultants, startup founders, interns and relocating individuals, these thoughtfully furnished rooms combine comfort, convenience and community living. Each room comes equipped with modern amenities and is supported by a professionally managed environment that allows residents to focus on work and life without everyday hassles.

Residents enjoy access to freshly prepared meals, a well-equipped gym, terrace garden, live café, gaming zones and dedicated resident support. Whether you're staying for a few months or planning a long-term stay, everything is designed to provide a comfortable, secure and enjoyable living experience.
neighbourhoodText: Located in one of Gurgaon's most preferred residential and commercial neighbourhoods, Sector 28 offers exceptional connectivity and a vibrant lifestyle. With major business districts, metro stations, shopping destinations, cafés and restaurants located nearby, residents enjoy the perfect balance of work, convenience and leisure.
